title: Complete cross-corpus overdetermination survey
description:
The session's overdetermination survey was thorough for the main draft but incomplete for the companion documents. Findings caught so far landed in epics uy1m (Tier 2 cleanups), ic5s (Tier 3 SHOULD+rationale), we5b (consistency follow-up), and the c93e545 / 9344aec / 38055ec / 970bad6 commits. What was NOT surveyed end-to-end is the federation draft, the WSS draft, the push draft post-edit, and the three implementer guides.

This epic completes the sweep. Each child surveys one document/area and either files specific findings (as separate beads or children of uy1m/ic5s/we5b) or closes the bead as no-findings.

These are independent of each other and parallelizable.
